arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ

translations.en.sahih: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
translations.en.pickthall: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
translations.en.yusufali: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
translations.id.indonesian: Bukankah Kami telah melapangkan untukmu dadamu?,

translations.en.sahih: And We removed from you your burden
translations.en.pickthall: And eased thee of the burden
translations.en.yusufali: And removed from thee thy burden
translations.id.indonesian: dan Kami telah menghilangkan daripadamu bebanmu,

translations.en.sahih: Which had weighed upon your back
translations.en.yusufali: The which did gall thy back?-

translations.en.sahih: And raised high for you your repute.
translations.en.yusufali: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?

translations.en.sahih: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
translations.en.pickthall: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,
translations.en.yusufali: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
translations.id.indonesian: Karena sesungguhnya sesudah kesulitan itu ada kemudahan,

translations.en.yusufali: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
translations.id.indonesian: sesungguhnya sesudah kesulitan itu ada kemudahan.

translations.en.sahih: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
translations.en.pickthall: So when thou art relieved, still toil
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apabila kamu telah selesai (dari sesuatu urusan), kerjakanlah dengan sungguh-sungguh (urusan) yang lain,

translations.en.sahih: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
translations.en.pickthall: And strive to please thy Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
translations.id.indonesian: dan hanya kepada Tuhanmulah hendaknya kamu berharap.
